description: Lets the Raven page served by the bundled Go server (http://127.0.0.1:<port>, the origin src/lib.rs navigates to; the port is 8090 unless that was taken at launch, hence the wildcard) use native notifications. WKWebView has no web Notification permission prompt, so the page calls window.__TAURI__.notification instead. It may also set the window theme (so the native title bar follows the page's light/dark mode) and drag/zoom the window from the page-drawn macOS title bar. Nothing else is exposed to the remote page.
